body:
Replaced defaultAccountTier/tierCaps manual-flip design with effectiveDailyCap(is_founder, registered_at) -- no new column (registered_at already IS account_created_date), no cutover-day intervention needed. Founder redeem now bumps to 9999 in the same response. Claim Account preservation of registered_at verified + regression-tested. Redeployed production. Commit 3b77bad.
